summary: Quiet residential kerb with homes within 15-25 m on both sides.

best_section.where: Greenlaw Street north kerb, east of the corner, under the big tree

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings on both sides within about 14-25 m; the nearest is 14 m on the same side.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a tree-lined verge; room for a van beside the lane looks adequate but is not certain.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with little through traffic.
drivers.convention: No parked vehicles on this kerb; no sign of overnight stays.

sun_shade: Heavy tree shade on the north side, mostly from the north and west.
